description: This Python module provides functions to read CSV data into Gherkin ScenarioOutline examples in a Behave testing framework, using special tags to specify CSV filenames.

methods.name: select_marker_tag_and_extract_filename
methods.description: Extracts CSV filename from a tag list if a tag starts with 'from_file='.

methods.name: select_examples_tables_with_marker_tag
methods.description: Yields examples and associated CSV filenames for examples tagged with 'from_file={filename}'.

methods.name: read_examples_table_data_from_csv
methods.description: Reads CSV data from a file and appends rows to the example's table, matching header columns.

methods.name: process_examples_tables_with_marker_tag_and_use_csv_file
methods.description: Processes feature's scenario outlines, loads CSV data into examples based on tags, and handles errors.
